credential_scan.coverage: aggregate regular-file tar payloads across all eight layers; repeated, overwritten, and later-whiteouted paths count separately; not a merged-rootfs count
credential_scan.detector: custom Python 3.14.8 standard-library byte and regular-expression scan
false_positives: one AWS-access-key-shaped substring in the libunistring Unicode-name table
credential_scan.limitations: supports no detected credential leakage under the recorded rules, not universal absence of unmodelled secret formats
credential_scan.metadata_coverage: manifest, config, inventory, SBOM, and four receipt files were also scanned but are excluded from the payload counts
credential_scan.secret_rule: exact byte search for the current registry secret returned by glab auth docker-helper

reviewer.role: read-only post-publication evidence reviewer; not a human approver or release authority
reviewer.separation: fresh post-publication analysis; did not participate in the build or publisher job and performed no repository, registry, tag, release, environment, rule, or CI-adoption mutation
reviewer.separation_limit: procedural and computational, not account-level or human organizational independence; existing GitLab identity janipaijanen was used for read APIs and pull-only registry access
